title: Listening Drill — Learning cartoon panels — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Learning cartoon panels — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on learning cartoon panels last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with cramped panels. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: faded marker.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of panel width so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow black pen instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the illustration tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Monday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
